The theorem determines it for every phase pattern on every odd binary Sidon support, finds the optimal alphabet-limited design and a sharp least phase-alphabet order on a canonical nonlinear support. Flat and coded windows have identical support and moduli but a strictly different identifiable operator dimension; this is a structural design threshold, not a normalization check or arbitrary numerical slice.
